title: static-site-hls index, version 2 (current)
description: <data-dir>/index.json: the settings of a site's static-site-hls data folder, every video the site's .scroll files use with the state of its HLS output, and which pages use which videos. Written by `static-site-hls convert`; older versions are migrated on load (src/migrations.js).

generator.description: package@version of the static-site-hls that last wrote this file.

settings.description: Options saved between runs, so later runs reuse them without flags.

videosDir.description: --videos-dir: folder, relative to the data folder, holding one folder of HLS output per video.

posters.description: --posters / --no-posters: whether every converted video gets poster.jpg.

videos.description: Source video (path relative to the site root) → its conversion state.

pages.description: .scroll file (path relative to the site root) → the converted source videos it plays. Only pages that play at least one converted video are listed.

relativePath.description: POSIX path relative to a folder: no leading or trailing slash, no empty, '.' or '..' segments, no backslashes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the source file's bytes, lowercase hex. A different hash means the source changed and is converted again.

convertedVideo.description: A video with HLS output in <data-dir>/<videosDir>/<id>/.

id.description: Folder of this video's output, relative to the videos folder. Stable across runs.

segments.description: Number of .ts segments next to index.m3u8.

duration.description: Seconds, as probed from the source.

audio.description: Audio codec in the output; 'aac (from <codec>)' when it was re-encoded.

poster.description: File name of the poster in the video's output folder. Absent when posters are off.

unsupportedVideo.description: A video that can't be stream-copied to HLS; pages keep using the original file until its content changes.
